subject.title: Route org publisher abuse nominations to org review

question: Should this draft MEMBER PR proceed as the org-publisher abuse review policy for ClawHub?
rationale: The change affects a security-sensitive moderation workflow and is maintainer-authored, so cleanup automation should not close or merge it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Continue maintainer review
options.body: Keep the PR open, review the org-level moderation policy and proof expectations, then undraft or merge through normal maintainer flow.

options.title: Request visual proof first
options.body: Ask for a real ClawHub management UI screenshot or browser proof of the org-review lane before undrafting.

options.title: Rework policy direction
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want org abuse nominations to remain in a generic policy queue instead of the new org-action lane.

recommendation.title: Continue maintainer review
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, review the org-level moderation policy and proof expectations, then undraft or merge through normal maintainer flow.

likelyOwner.reason: jesse-merhi has the most recent current-main work in publisher-abuse moderation and authored this policy implementation.
